note: Chippewa County campground on a wooded peninsula in Lake Holcombe (Holcombe Flowage). Fifteen shoreline sites have their own boat dock; sites 1-5 sit apart along the entry road. Beach, swim area, playground, pavilion and boat launch. --Claude
summary: County page, campground map PDF, terms PDF, contact page, OSM and imagery read. 48 sites, 20/30/50A at all; fees $20-32 (+$7 electric, +$5 dock) with $7 reservation fee; season May 1-Oct 31 confirmed (manual); reservations close 10 days out, then caretaker walk-up; reservation minimum 3 nights / max 14. Lakefront kept on the official per-site dock map. Pin ~400 m south of the loops. Phone and county website changed.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE? (3-night minimum): the county terms (dated 4-9-25, linked from the current campground page) say 'All reservations must be made a minimum of 10 days prior to park arrival date - three-night minimum, fourteen-night maximum per reservation'. It covers every reservation all season, but the same terms sell unreserved sites by the night: 'Unreserved sites are sold by the park caretaker, first come, first served on the night you want to camp', and mid-September through October is all self-registration. So a single night is possible walk-up only. The current campground page itself states no minimum. Reviewer decides.

WATERFRONT: lakefront kept. The official map draws 15 'Site with Dock' sites on the shore: 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 28, 36, 38, 40 (west and north shore of the peninsula around 45.2450-45.2468,-91.1555 to -91.1585). All are ordinary reservable/walk-up nightly sites. Imagery is canopy-blind (continuous fall canopy, pads not resolvable), so the call rests on the per-site dock map; a site with its own dock is at the water.

PIN MOVE ~400 m: stored 45.2417,-91.1566 sits south on 256th St near the park entry; the camping loops on the peninsula center about 45.2453,-91.1568 (OSM camp_site node 45.24474,-91.15775; north restroom 'Across from Sites 20-26' at 45.24638,-91.15599). Proposed 45.2453,-91.1568.
